name: Ossirian the Unscarred
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/ruins-of-ahnqiraj/ossirian.md (no Era HP: wiki ~500,000 versus SoM 2,398,320; the boss's HP is a clock). ESTIMATES: the terrace is drawn 92 by 74 yd; the fight is 270 s, six chained 45 s Weakness windows (DBM and BigWigs give 45 s; for crystals 1-5 a 27 s hold then an 18 s walk to the next crystal inside the same Weakness, and the sixth window holds for 45 s), compressing the real 8-12 windows and 6-8 minutes; schools per window are placeholders. UNVERIFIED: the real terrace layout (no map or coordinates: crystal positions are estimates). THE KITE IS THE FIGHT and is the main thing simulated. Crystal k stands at a fixed spot; the raid clicks the next crystal with 10-15 s left so the next Weakness lands before the current one ends, and the tank walks him to the next crystal inside the window (Wowhead guide: he moves 15-20 s into it; wiki: never let the Weakness expire with him in melee of anyone). A lapse is the failure case, not the rhythm: `strength` (Strength of Ossirian, `enrage` for 6.5 s, +300% melee at `enrageMultiplier` 4, matching +300% physical damage in the real spell data) is out of the rotation and appears only in the `lapseDrill`. The sim cannot end a window early or fail to land a Weakness, so a late walk scores a missed `bossAtSpot` rather than a wipe, and he does not get faster 10 s into the fight (the 2.2x run speed) because `boss.speed` is one number per script. Crystal clicking (5 s cast, spotter, clicker roles) is not modelled at all: crystals are places, weaknesses are phases, and the school weakness has no effect on DPS because the engine does not split damage by school. Boss melee (700 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank lives on the raid's passive healing in the windows and dies if a player healer ignores it (`healPerSecondWithPlayerHealer` 100). Real melee during Strength hits for 10,000+ (TenTonHammer); the 4x multiplier of 700 is 2,800 here, so being caught under Strength hurts but is not fatal in one swing: an honest difference. Enveloping Winds (real 20 s then 20 s on the emulators; here every 19 s on one timeline through the whole fight, first at 9 s, so a stun can land inside a walk and the tank has to take him back and still get him to the next crystal) is a 10 s stun on the tank (the Free Action Potion answer is not modelled) with a `targetSwitch` handing him to the raid anchor for those 10 s (the real target is the off-tank at number two on threat). The raid anchor stands 10 yd from him for this reason, which is unrealistically close for 'raid 20 yd back'. War Stomp (real 30 s/30 s, here once per window in the hold, in a gap where Winds has not pulled him off his crystal, because casters who stand outside its 20 yd reach of the crystal would otherwise be inside it when he walks toward the raid) is a radial 20 yd `knockback` of 12 yd for 1,800 (the 2,188-2,812 of wotlkdb, ~1,500 of guides, ~3,000 reported when buffed: middle of the first two); ranged and healers stand outside its 20 yd reach, and in melee it is unavoidable, so `stompsTaken` is informational. Curse of Tongues (DBM: first 17.8-50.2 s, then every 21-43.7 s; here once per window at 18 s plus 0-8 s into the hold; 15 s duration) is `dispel: curse` on everyone. The two Sand Vortexes are `hazard`s of radius 10 stepping between waypoints every 7 s to imitate roaming (wiki: they wander; emulators give both fixed and random paths), on a 19-20 yd ring that keeps 14 yd from every tank spot, since a vortex on the tank cannot be dodged while Winds has them stunned; damage 1,500 per second (Harsh Winds ~2,000 per second, 10 yd radius) and `applies` `harshWinds`, a 3 s `forbidAbilities` debuff on healer and ranged standing in for its Silence and scored by `castInVortex`. Its -85% run speed and aggro loss remain engine gaps (a hazard cannot slow a player or wipe a tank's threat). No DPS during the first window is `raid.holdAfterPull` 45 s (Wowhead: no DPS in the first window) with `earlyAttacks` penalties. Ossirian is immune to Taunt in the real fight: the Taunt button stands for regaining threat with Sunder and is a known approximation.

labels.text: Raid walks with the tank, crystal to crystal

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold him on the first crystal while the raid does nothing. Then the whole fight is one rule: walk him to the next crystal while the Weakness is up. If a window ever lapses, he hits for 10,000+ under Strength. When Enveloping Winds stuns you for 10 s, he goes to the off-tank; take him back as soon as you are free. (The Taunt button stands for regaining threat. He cannot be Taunted in the real fight.)

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Melee are optional in this fight. Attack from behind him only during weakness windows, come back on him after War Stomp throws you and keep clear of the roaming tornadoes.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: No damage during the first window. After that stay 20 to 30 yards behind the tank, walk with the raid crystal to crystal, decurse Curse of Tongues when you can, and keep clear of the roaming tornadoes.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Move with the tank each window. Decurse Curse of Tongues off healers and casters first. Heal the tank up after Enveloping Winds and through War Stomp.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Remove Curse or Remove Lesser Curse. Healers and casters first.

vortexA0.tip: A roaming tornado: about 2,000 per second, Silence, -85% run speed and you lose your aggro. Stay clear of it.

strength.label: Strength of Ossirian
strength.toast: You let the window lapse: Strength is back. He hits for ten thousand.
strength.tip: A Weakness window lapsed: +300% physical damage. Stay out of his melee until the next Weakness.

envelopingWinds.label: Enveloping Winds
envelopingWinds.tip: Ten seconds stunned on the top-threat target. He turns on the next tank until you are free.

windsSwitch.label: Winds: he goes to the off-tank
windsSwitch.toast: Enveloping Winds: he is on the off-tank for 10 s
windsSwitch.tip: The off-tank holds him for 10 s while you are stunned.

warStomp.label: War Stomp
warStomp.tip: A 20 yard radial stomp for about 1,500 and a 12 yard knockback.

harshWinds.label: Harsh Winds
harshWinds.tip: Caught in a Sand Vortex: Silenced for 3 s. Press nothing until it ends.

curseOfTongues.label: Curse of Tongues
curseOfTongues.tip: Curse on everyone within 45 yards: +75% cast time for 15 s. Decursers: healers and casters first.

phases.name: Crystal 1: hold
phases.subtitle: Tanks build threat. Nobody else attacks.

expectations.label: Hold him on the first crystal
expectations.tip: He comes down the stairs. Take him onto the first crystal and hold him there.

expectations.label: No damage during the first weakness
expectations.tip: Let the tanks build threat. He cannot be Taunted.

expectations.label: Take him back after Enveloping Winds
expectations.tip: You are stunned for 10 s. When you are free, take him straight back, Sunder and threat.

expectations.label: Decurse Curse of Tongues
expectations.tip: Remove it from healers and casters first. It adds 75% to every cast.

expectations.label: Melee: stay topped for War Stomp
expectations.tip: Stomp is about 2,000 and a knockback within 20 yards every 30 seconds. In melee you cannot avoid it, so keep your health up.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Melee and War Stomp are steady. The dangerous bit is the Enveloping Winds gap.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Stay above half: Enveloping Winds takes the tank away for 10 s right when it matters.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the first weakness had ended
earlyAttacks.tip: No damage during the first weakness: the tanks need that time.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with Curse of Tongues up
debuffSeconds.tip: Decurse healers and casters first, instantly.

stompsTaken.label: War Stomps taken
stompsTaken.tip: In melee you take it. Keep your health up.

castInVortex.label: Pressed while caught in a Sand Vortex
castInVortex.tip: A Sand Vortex silences you. Get out and press nothing until it ends.

cues.notes: Taunt him back after Winds; decurse Curse of Tongues.

list.label: Taunt when Ossirian turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Dispel the moment it lands. Tank first, then healers, then everyone else.

list.label: Decurse Curse of Tongues
list.tip: Remove the curse from healers and casters first.

drills.name: When a window lapses
drills.description: You let the window lapse: Strength is back, stay out of his melee until the next Weakness.

drills.name: Crystal to crystal
drills.description: Walk him from crystal to crystal inside the Weakness. Enveloping Winds stuns you for 10 s and War Stomp throws you: take him back and have him on the next crystal before the window ends.

drills.name: Dodging the Sand Vortex
drills.description: Tornadoes step around the terrace. Keep clear of them while you attack.

drills.name: Curse of Tongues
drills.description: Decurse every 8 s. Healers and casters first.
